remarks: Welcome to 9 Edgewood St #A, ideally located in the Brookside neighborhood in the heart of South Norwalk. This beautifully updated, move-in-ready home features 2 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, offering the perfect blend of location, lifestyle, and opportunity.  Recent improvements include new central air conditioning, a conversion from electric heat to natural gas, a renovated lower-level bathroom, and fresh interior paint. The walkout lower level provides valuable and versatile additional living space with convenient exterior access-ideal for a family room, home office, recreation area, or flex space.  Enjoy easy access to the train station, restaurants, shopping, entertainment, I-95, and Route 7, along with everything vibrant SoNo has to offer. The home is also just minutes from The SoNo Collection and the many conveniences and attractions of South Norwalk.  Offering the perfect combination of modern updates, convenience, and an exciting SoNo lifestyle, this home is ready for its next owner.  Don't miss this turnkey opportunity-schedule your private showing today!
